redundancyType.description: Immutable. Indicates the redundancy type of this external VPN gateway. Possible values: ["FOUR_IPS_REDUNDANCY", "SINGLE_IP_INTERNALLY_REDUNDANT", "TWO_IPS_REDUNDANCY"].
